title: Hosted API launch card + code slate: compact walkthrough screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact visual asset pack for the Hosted API getting-started doc and quickstart flow. The goal is a lightweight set of annotated screenshots that can be dropped into the docs, the Console tour, and the launchpad. Emphasize the model selector, request builder (compact card + expanded JSON editor), three language code snippets, and one streaming-response snapshot. Assets must include light and dark theme variants and accessible alt text. Deliver annotated PNGs and a single compact sprite PNG for the docs hero.
acceptance_criteria: 8 final PNGs: model-selector (2 themes), request-builder compact, request-builder expanded, streaming response, structured-output example, function-calling example, code-slate overview
3 code snippets exported as separate files: python_snippet.txt, node_snippet.txt, curl_snippet.txt with copy-ready content matching docs runtime examples
All screenshots include copy-ready alt text and a one-line caption in metadata
Annotations match PM voice and Console copy; approved by PM
Files uploaded to Drive folder and referenced in PR; links included in ticket
design_notes: Prefer compact card composition used in Console: top-left model pill, center request preview, right-hand token/cost hint
Request builder expanded view should show structured output schema panel collapsed by default
Use 1200x700 export for hero images and 760x420 for inline doc images
Follow existing Redwood UI tokens: rounded-6, neutral-600 for borders, brand-500 for CTA highlights
Include a low-contrast overlay for callouts to mirror docs typography hierarchy
screenshots_needed: Model selector modal with 'gpt-small' and 'redwood-encoder' highlighted
Compact request builder showing prompt, temperature, max_tokens fields
Expanded request builder with JSON schema preview and function-calling toggle
Streaming response with progressive tokens and cancel button visible
Structured output example demonstrating JSON schema enforcement
Function-calling example showing args payload and returned values
Hero composite for docs with callout labels
code_snippets: Python snippet mirrors docs: redwood.Client, client.responses.create(..., streaming=True) example
Node snippet uses SDK examples with stream.on('data') handler
curl snippet uses --stream and shows chunked responses for streaming example
